question: Name the PETA India Person of the Year for 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alia Bhatt**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) has named Alia Bhatt as its Person of the Year 2021.
 
• Alia had also set up a program titled Coexist which is a platform that highlights and works towards the issues of animal and ecological welfare.
 
• Alia's vegan-friendly kidswear line, Ed-a-Mamma, also won a 2021 PETA India fashion award for helping nurture kids’ love for animals and nature.
 
• Alia had also invested in Phool, the company behind Fleather, a vegan leather made from discarded temple flowers.
 
• She also previously starred in a pro-adoption PETA India campaign to help cats and dogs and has used her platform to call for stronger animal protection laws.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Past recipients of PETA India’s Person of the Year Award include:
 
 
• Dr. Shashi Tharoor
 
• Justice KS Panicker Radhakrishnan
 
• Virat Kohli
 
• Kapil Sharma
 
• John Abraham
 
• Anushka Sharma
 
• Sunny Leone
 
• R Madhavan
 
• Jacqueline Fernandez
 
• Hema Malini
 
• Sonam Kapoor Ahuja
